locked_conventions.source_interval: [-lambda,lambda] with Lebesgue measure and zero extension
locked_conventions.physical_interval: I_lambda=[-log(lambda),log(lambda)] with Lebesgue measure in logarithmic coordinates, equivalently du/u on [lambda^(-1),lambda]
locked_conventions.prime_endpoint: every prime power n<=lambda^2 is included
locked_conventions.inversion: multiplicatively Jf(u)=f(u^(-1)); in the additive logarithmic coordinate Jf(x)=f(-x), and reflection is retained before forming the inversion-even state
locked_conventions.matched_schedule: lambda=p/2 for odd p>=5 and N=ceil(lambda^2)=(p^2+3)/4
locked_conventions.matched_even_count_scope: the even ambient-complement dimension and count comparison require the unproved finite hypothesis P_(E_N^+)p_4!=0 at N=ceil(lambda^2)
locked_conventions.strict_capture_projector: Pi_>=1_(g-delta,infinity)(mathscr_R), distinct from the inclusive rank projector
locked_conventions.interval_serialization: nondegenerate intervals are expanded by exact dyadic 2^(s-ceil(dps*3321928094887363/10^15)+16), s=max(0,floor(log2(max endpoint magnitude))), and replay requires enclosure of its independent interval
locked_conventions.shared_library: producer and replay use the exact pinned mpmath.iv version and disclose that common dependency
